parsed.critic: C01 and C02 both carry 22 and 11.6 kg/m3 superplasticizer with low water and slag, a combination far from observed mixes, so the extrapolation risk is real even though the cement-plus-slag base matches mix-350's high-strength signature.
parsed.selection_rationale: These five pair top predictions with low fly-ash content and the strongest observed cement/slag pattern, and their spread of binder and admixture levels hedges the model disagreement while keeping upside from mix-401-like cement dosing.

decision.critic: C01 and C02 both carry 22 and 11.6 kg/m3 superplasticizer with low water and slag, a combination far from observed mixes, so the extrapolation risk is real even though the cement-plus-slag base matches mix-350's high-strength signature.
